item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 21/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will cover southeastern China today and tomorrow, the weather will be generally fine over the region. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the seas east of Luzon may enter the South China Sea over the weekend. However, there are still uncertainties in its intensity. The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China early next week. It will be windy over the region.
